name: The Gun Club
description: '''The Gun Club''' were an American [[rock music|rock]] band from Los Angeles that existed from 1979 to 1996, formed and led by singer-songwriter and guitarist [[Jeffrey Lee Pierce]]. They were notable as one of the first bands in the [[punk rock]] [[subculture]] to incorporate influences from [[blues]], [[rockabilly]], and [[country music]]. The Gun Club has been called a "tribal [[psychobilly]] blues" band, as well as initiators of [[punk blues]] and [[cowpunk]]
